fields.label: Setup Guide: where each value comes from
Setup Guide
fields.options:
Make one Mpesa Settings record per shortcode. One shortcode can collect (Paybill, STK) and pay out (B2C, B2B) when Safaricom has set it up as an M-PESA Business One Account: then use a single record for all of it. Make a separate record only for a separate number, e.g. an older dedicated B2C (bulk) shortcode. Do steps 1–3 once per site, steps 4–7 for every record. Each field below also says where its value comes from.

1. Once per site: a public HTTPS address

Safaricom sends every result to your site, so it must be reachable from the internet over https. Tell Frappe that address (run on the server):
bench --site <your-site> set-config host_name https://erp.yourcompany.co.ke
Callback URLs are built from this value. A wrong or internal address means payments arrive at Safaricom but never reach ERPNext.

2. Once per site: M-Pesa Suite Settings
  • Integration User: create a System User with only Accounts User and the M-Pesa roles it needs, and select it here. Then set If No Integration User to Refuse.
  • Leave Verify C2B Confirmations and Verify STK Callbacks ticked. They need the Initiator Name and Initiator Password (step 5) on each record.
  • The Callback Token is generated for you. Turn on the token checks only after step 6 has registered your URLs.
3. Once per site: Mpesa Public Key Certificate (usually nothing to do)

Safaricom's sandbox and production certificates ship with the app and are used to encrypt the Initiator Password. Upload a file there only if Safaricom issues a new certificate (Daraja → Docs → Security Credentials).

4. Get credentials from Safaricom
WhatTesting (Sandbox ticked)Live (Sandbox unticked)
Consumer Key / Secretdeveloper.safaricom.co.ke → My Apps → Add a new app (tick the APIs you need) → copy Consumer Key and Consumer Secret.Daraja → Go Live for the shortcode (done by its M-PESA Business Administrator, confirmed by OTP). The production app then appears under My Apps with its own Consumer Key and Secret.
Business Shortcode174379 (the M-Pesa Express test shortcode on Daraja's Test Credentials page).Pay Bill: your paybill number. Buy Goods: the Head Office / Store number that M-Pesa Express was approved for (not the till).
Till NumberThe test shortcode (600xxx) from Daraja's Test Credentials page. In sandbox it is used for C2B URL registration and as Party A for B2C, B2B, Reversal, Transaction Status and Balance, so one record can hold 174379 for STK and 600xxx for the rest.Buy Goods only: the Till number customers pay to.
Online PassKeyDaraja → APIs → M-Pesa Express → Simulator / Test Credentials (passkey for 174379).Emailed by Safaricom after Go Live for M-Pesa Express (Lipa Na M-Pesa Online). C2B- or B2C-only records: any text (the field is required).
Initiator Name / PasswordDaraja Test Credentials: Initiator Name and Initiator Password.M-PESA Org Portal: the Business Administrator creates an API operator for the shortcode with the API roles you need (Transaction Status, Account Balance, B2C, Reversal) and sets its password. Its username is the Initiator Name.
Pull Nominated NumberNot available in sandbox.Apply to Safaricom (M-PESA Business / API support) to enable the Pull Transaction API for the shortcode. The phone number you nominate there (2547XXXXXXXX) goes in Pull Transaction Nominated Number.
5. Fill in this form and save
  1. Payment Gateway Name: a short name such as Paybill 123456. It becomes the Payment Gateway and Mode of Payment Mpesa-<name> and cannot be renamed later.
  2. Sandbox, Paybill Type, then tick every API the shortcode uses under APIs this record uses (Receive C2B, STK Prompts, B2C, B2B, Reversals), then the Safaricom values from step 4.
  3. Company, then under Accounting Mapping: Bank Account (a Company Bank Account for this shortcode, e.g. "M-Pesa Paybill 123456"), Cost Center, and M-Pesa Charges Account. Saving with a Company creates the Payment Gateway Account and the Mode of Payment for it.
  4. Type the Initiator Password. On save, the Security Credential is generated from it. Never paste one in by hand. If Safaricom answers "initiator information is invalid", re-type the password and save, or use Security → Regenerate Security Credential.
6. Connect it to Safaricom
  • Receiving C2B (Pay Bill / Till): create an Mpesa C2B Payment Register URL record for this Mpesa Settings, choose its Company and Mode of Payment, and save. Register Status must show Success. If host_name or the callback token changes later, open that record and press Register URLs Again.
  • Pull Transactions (catches payments whose confirmation never arrived): after Safaricom enables Pull, enter the Nominated Number, then use Pull Transaction → Register Pull Transaction and tick Enable Hourly Pull Transactions.
  • B2C payouts: on a Business One Account, pay out from this same record (collections fund the payouts). With a separate bulk B2C shortcode, make a record for that number with only B2C Payouts ticked. Either way B2C pays from the Utility account, so keep it funded. The API operator (Initiator) needs a role for each API you use: B2C, Business Pay Bill (B2B), Transaction Status, Balance Query, Reversal.
7. Test it
  • Get Account Balance proves the Consumer Key/Secret, Initiator and Security Credential in one go.
  • Send an STK prompt of KES 1 to your own phone (Payment Request or POS) and check that the receipt is booked.
  • Pay KES 1 to the paybill/till from a phone and check that a Mpesa C2B Payment Register appears.
Common errors
404.001.03 Invalid Access TokenWrong Consumer Key/Secret, or Sandbox ticked/unticked for the wrong keys.
2001 Initiator information is invalidWrong Initiator Name or Password, or the credential was made for the other environment. Re-type the Initiator Password and save (or Security → Regenerate Security Credential).
C2B "already registered"Safaricom keeps the first registration. Treated as Success. If the old URLs were wrong, ask Safaricom API support to delete the registration, then press Register URLs Again.
STK 1032 / 1037Customer cancelled the prompt, or the phone did not answer in time. Nothing was paid.
Payments not reaching ERPNextCheck host_name (step 1), that the site is reachable on https, and Rejected Callbacks in M-Pesa Suite Settings.

fields.label: Payment Gateway Name
fields.description: A short name for this shortcode, e.g. 'Paybill 123456'. It becomes the Payment Gateway and Mode of Payment 'Mpesa-<name>' and cannot be renamed later.

fields.label: Consumer Key
fields.description: Daraja portal (developer.safaricom.co.ke) > My Apps > your app > Consumer Key. Use the sandbox app while testing and the production app after Go Live.

fields.label: Consumer Secret
fields.description: Same app on Daraja > My Apps > Consumer Secret. Stored encrypted.

fields.label: Initiator Name
fields.description: Username of the API operator. Live: created by the Business Administrator on the M-PESA Org Portal (org.ke.m-pesa.com) with the API roles you need. Sandbox: Initiator Name on Daraja's Test Credentials. Needed for Transaction Status, Account Balance, B2C, Reversal and C2B verification.

fields.label: Transaction Limit
fields.description: Largest amount per STK prompt, in KES (blank, or above 250,000, means Safaricom's maximum of 250,000). A Payment Request above it is refused when submitted: raise the limit, or ask for the amount in several Payment Requests, one after the other.

fields.label: Sandbox
fields.description: Tick while using Daraja sandbox credentials. Untick only with the production keys from your Go Live app. Changing it regenerates the Security Credential.

fields.label: Business Shortcode
fields.description: Pay Bill: your paybill number. Buy Goods: the Head Office / Store number that M-Pesa Express was approved for (not the till). Sandbox: 174379.

fields.label: Online PassKey
fields.description: M-Pesa Express (Lipa Na M-Pesa Online) passkey. Sandbox: Daraja > APIs > M-Pesa Express > Test Credentials. Live: emailed by Safaricom after Go Live. C2B- or B2C-only records: any text.

fields.label: Security Credential
fields.description: Filled in automatically: the Initiator Password encrypted with Safaricom's sandbox or production certificate. Do not paste anything here. Re-type the Initiator Password or use Security > Regenerate Security Credential.

fields.label: Old API Type
fields.options:
MPesa Express
MPesa C2B (Customer to Business)
MPesa B2C (Business to Customer)
fields.description: Upstream's single-purpose setting, kept for reference only. The switches under APIs this record uses decide what the record may do.
Tick every API this shortcode uses. One M-PESA Business One Account can collect and pay out from a single record. Transaction Status and Account Balance need no switch.
fields.label: APIs this record uses

fields.description: Paybill / Till payments arrive here (C2B URL registration). Payments Safaricom reports are always recorded, ticked or not.
fields.label: Receive C2B (Paybill / Till)

fields.description: Send M-Pesa Express (STK) prompts from this record. Needs the Online PassKey.
fields.label: Send STK Prompts (M-Pesa Express)

fields.description: Pay out to phones. The API operator needs the ORG B2C API Initiator role.
fields.label: B2C Payouts

fields.description: Pay suppliers' paybills and tills. The API operator needs the Business Paybill / Business Buy Goods Org API initiator roles. Debits the Working account.
fields.label: B2B Supplier Payments

fields.description: Reverse C2B and STK payments received here. The API operator needs the Org Reversals Initiator role.
fields.label: Reversals
Paybill Type
fields.description: Pay Bill: customers pay to a business number plus an account number. Buy Goods: customers pay to a Till number.

fields.label: Initiator Password
fields.description: Password of that API operator (set on the Org Portal; sandbox: Daraja Test Credentials). Typing it regenerates the Security Credential. Stored encrypted.

fields.label: Till Number
fields.description: Buy Goods: the Till number customers pay to. Sandbox (any type): the test shortcode (600xxx) from Daraja's Test Credentials page; used for C2B registration, Pull, and as Party A for B2C, B2B, Reversal, Transaction Status and Balance (174379 is for M-Pesa Express only).

fields.label: Auto Create Sales Invoice
fields.description: Create a Sales Invoice for C2B payments that match no open invoice.

fields.label: Auto Reconcile C2B Payments
fields.description: Match incoming C2B payments to open invoices using the Reconciliation Priority table.
Journal Entries, Payment Entries or Loan Disbursements
fields.label: Submit B2C Accounting Entries

fields.description: Defines the order and fields used to auto-reconcile M-Pesa C2B payments. The system matches payments sequentially based on this table (e.g., Customer by ID → Customer by PIN → Sales Invoice by ID) until a successful reconciliation. Works for PayBill transactions referencing an account.
fields.label: Reconciliation Priority

fields.description: Allows user to enter their own payment amount
fields.label: Allow Amount Editing

fields.description: Allows the user to edit the Reference ID and, if a Reconciliation Priority is set, also allows changing the Reference Type.
fields.label: Allow Payment Reference Editing

fields.description: Select the source currency to convert from, and specify the exchange rate to KES. If Currency Exchange is enabled, these rates will take precedence and override the system exchange rates; otherwise, the system exchange rates will be used.
fields.label: Exchange Rates

fields.description: The phone number (2547XXXXXXXX) you nominated when applying to Safaricom for the Pull Transaction API. Then use Pull Transaction > Register Pull Transaction.
fields.label: Pull Transaction Nominated Number

fields.description: If checked, pulls transactions once every hour: the last 2 hours, then the last 47 hours (Safaricom keeps 48), so receipts whose confirmation was lost during an outage are recovered. Receipts that already have a register, cancelled or deleted ones included, are skipped.
fields.label: Enable Hourly Pull Transactions

fields.description: Set by Register Pull Transaction. 'Already Registered' means Safaricom already has this shortcode enrolled.
fields.label: Pull Registration Status

fields.description: Success = Safaricom returned data. No Data = code 1001, which also means the shortcode may not be provisioned for Pull. Error = the request failed.
fields.label: Last Pull Status
